description: This file defines a PHP class 'Basic' which extends the Opencart system Controller. It manages CAPTCHA functionality in the OpenCart admin extension, including displaying the CAPTCHA settings page and saving configuration changes.

classes.name: Basic
classes.description: Controller class for managing the CAPTCHA settings in the OpenCart admin extension.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles displaying the CAPTCHA configuration page, including setting up breadcrumbs, page titles, and loading necessary controllers and views.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes saving the CAPTCHA configuration settings, including permission check, updating settings, and returning a JSON response.
